questions.question: Why is it important that the leading edge of supersonic aircraft wings be kept free from dents and damage?

If the leading edge has dents or blunt surfaces, a normal shockwave forms and slows the air behind it to subsonic. Oblique shock waves are incline angled to airflow direction; normal shock waves are perpendicular to airflow direction.
